root_idea.summary: The root centers on attachment: one thing clinging to, being suspended from, or remaining connected with another.
root_idea.development: From the basic image of an object being hung from something elevated or clinging to it, the language extends to dependence, persistent attachment, attraction, contention, suspended states, clotted blood, and things used for suspension.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the Quranic plural or collective noun عَلَق.
Displayed under the singular dictionary form عَلَقَة.
Displayed as the substantivized feminine passive participle مُعَلَّقَة.

senses.definition: Clotted blood or blood-clots, understood as a clinging mass.
senses.usage_conditions: In 96:2, عَلَق denotes the clotted, clinging substance from which the human being is created; it is a plural or collective expression related to عَلَقَة.

senses.definition: A clinging or clotted blood mass; specifically, the embryonic stage described as a blood-like mass from which the next stage develops.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic descriptions of human formation, including the transition from نُطْفَة to عَلَقَة and then to مُضْغَة. The definition describes the lexical image attested by the exegetical explanations, not a restriction to a particular modern biological category.

senses.definition: A woman left in suspense: neither treated as a fully retained wife nor released by divorce.
senses.usage_conditions: In 4:129, the passive-participial form describes an unsettled marital status in which the husband neither acts equitably toward the wife nor releases her.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hang from, cling to, catch upon, adhere to, or remain fast to something; by extension, to be held fast by an opponent or circumstance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the relevant prepositions or objects for physical attachment, being caught in a snare, and figurative holding fast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To depend upon something as a condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The dependent matter is construed with عَلَى or عَلَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pertain to, concern, or give someone a hold or interest in something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of attachment to a matter or affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become attached in love; to love with a desirous or heart-clinging attachment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attachment may be expressed with بِ or فِي; the lexical evidence includes love between a man and a woman and persistent love generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persistent adherence or tenacity; being intent on a matter and not letting it go.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also applied to a person or soul that remains devoted to, or persistently clings to, something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take hold and have its effect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of old age or anything whose effects have taken hold in their proper place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture, or to feed by reaching and taking leaves or other plant matter with the mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of camels and other animals feeding on trees, pasture, or a plant; the image is of reaching into vegetation and taking hold of it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To engage in persistent contention, disputation, or litigation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative sense presents an antagonist as clinging to an opponent or to an argument.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suit, befit, or be appropriate to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded especially in the negative expression لَا يَعْلَقُ بِكَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set about, begin, or betake oneself to doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action begun is expressed by the following verb or verbal phrase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To continue without ceasing to say or do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary lexical use is recorded in مَا عَلِقْتُ أَقُولُهُ, meaning that the speaker did not cease saying it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat or take food; of a child, to suck the fingers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of animals taking leaves, fruit, or other food with the mouth and of a child sucking his fingers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To revile, blame, or censure someone by saying something he dislikes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive verbal construction involving the tongue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To know or understand an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately recorded verbal use with أَمْرَهُ as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceive or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a woman; the lexical image is that conception has taken hold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leeches or blood-sucking aquatic worms that cling to the throat or mouth of a person or animal and suck blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of a person or animal to whose throat leeches have clung while drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hang, suspend, attach, or cause something to cling to another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be hung on, behind, or from another object; the construction also includes attaching an amulet or making a structure supported above the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a matter depend on a condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِ or عَلَى for conditional dependence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To append or place a note in the margin of a book or writing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized literary use derived from attaching something to a written work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set up and fix a door in a house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes attaching or installing the door to the house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To close or fasten a door with a latch or sliding bolt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinct from locking with a key; the described implement is attached to and pushed against the door.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attach responsibility for a person's blood to oneself, as the killer of that person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recorded wording is textually uncertain between active and passive readings, but the reported construction concerns liability for a killing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To join someone and overtake him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived verbal use recorded without a further constructional restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To learn something and take or receive it from another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense concerns acquiring information or an item from another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone something that sustains or arrests what remains of his life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of providing food or another thing sufficient to preserve remaining life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send a camel with a person or group to bring grain or provisions for the sender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel is sent for provisioning and may be used by turns rather than as the sender's constant mount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave or move away from one's she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as an imperative expression meaning to go away from the camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie or contend with someone for superiority in precious things, or to wager precious articles against him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object of rivalry is a valued or precious possession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cord, thong, strap, or implement by which something is hung or attached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of suspension devices for a bow, whip, sword, shield, book, Quran copy, water-skin, vessel, meat, grapes, or similar objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause game or another animal to be caught or stuck in a snare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the hunter or the snare that results in the animal's being held fast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To apply or let leeches attach to a place so that they draw blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical or therapeutic causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find, encounter, or light upon a precious article of property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object encountered is something rare or highly valued.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring about a calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَعْلَقَ وَأَفْلَقَ and related expressions for bringing about something disastrous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove a calamity or misfortune from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative-with-removal construction recorded separately from bringing about a calamity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To press or raise a child's throat swelling with the finger as a traditional treatment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action concerns the swelling called عُذْرَة near the uvula.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put one's hand into one's throat to induce vomiting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive medical or bodily action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become distant or remote.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as a usage said of countries or regions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tear, fray, or pulled place in a garment or similar material caused by catching on a thorn or tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may also denote the thing that catches and pulls the garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of reviling or abusive reproach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An infinitival noun corresponding to the verbal use of blaming by the tongue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tree used for tanning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical and technical noun distinct from the attachment senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A precious, highly valued, or carefully treasured thing; especially valued property, clothing, a shield, a sword, or similar goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recorded definition excludes animate beings in its primary formulation; the word can also be applied specifically to a valued garment or property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine, especially old wine, viewed as something highly prized.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the meaning ‘precious or highly valued.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person strongly devoted to or pursuing a subject, whether knowledge, good, or evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with the pursued object, such as عِلْقُ عِلْمٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A travelling provisions-bag or travelling pack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use recorded for a travel container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something hung or suspended, including a suspended cluster of grapes or dates and, in a conventional expression, suspended odes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This denotes the suspended object itself rather than the cord or implement used to suspend it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The gear or apparatus of a pulley well, including its suspensory rope, pulley, bucket, axle, and associated supports.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact scope varies in the reported descriptions, from the pulley apparatus to the complete equipment for drawing water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small quantity or bare sufficiency of food, fodder, pasture, or means of subsistence; something remaining that is enough to sustain life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of human food, animal provisions, a remaining share, or a limited livelihood; it can also describe being content with little.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small or short garment, such as a sleeveless shirt or an unsewn-sided garment worn to the waist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records several garment types under this headword, including a child's first garment and a girl's work garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shield.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use recorded alongside the garment sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular desert plant or tree whose slender twigs are used for brooms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plant is described as remaining green in hot weather and growing in sandy or open tracts; its grammatical number is reported variably.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Race, stock, or family line.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as one interpretation of a dialectal expression; another interpretation treats the form as a plural of عِلْق meaning precious things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cling, cleave, or stick fast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An imperative verbal noun used as a command.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death or the decree of death, understood as something that clings to a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic and proverbial nominal use; the same form may also denote a calamity in related contexts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The stallion's semen, according to one interpretation of a poetic use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation connected with the change in the she-camels after conception; it is distinct from the general pasture sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk remaining in a she-camel's udder; in the negative expression, no milk remains because it has all been milked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in مَا بِالنَّاقَةِ عَلُوقٌ and related expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that does not properly accept or nurse a young one, or that inclines to it but later refuses it or withholds her milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptions vary as to whether the camel rejects the young one from the outset or accepts it briefly before driving it away; the related proverb extends the image to speech without corresponding action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who loves no one other than her husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization derived from the idea of exclusive attachment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who suckles another person's child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use distinct from the she-camel sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Yawning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately recorded lexical equivalence with ثُؤَبَاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fodder, especially barley or similar provender hung in a nose-bag for a horse or other beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is associated with feeding an animal by hanging the food from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An attachment, tie, or connection between things or persons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun covers mental attachments such as love or contention and extrinsic attachments involving objects such as a bow or whip.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A retained claim, share, right, or obligation attaching one person to another or to property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a remaining interest in a sale or house, an agreed portion of a dowry, obligations of bloodwits, and related blood-revenge claims.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A work, craft, possession, wife, child, love, contention, or other concern to which a person is attached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective use for the affairs or attachments belonging to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Articles of merchandise or goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as a plural use of the attachment-related noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A surname or by-name attached to a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The naming sense is explained through attachment to the person who bears it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A nose-bag or feed-bag hung from the head of a horse or similar animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or current use of the container associated with hanging fodder on an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular plant, recorded without further botanical specification.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source gives the plant name but does not identify it with the more fully described عَلْقَى or عُلَّيْق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thorny climbing plant that catches objects in its hooked thorns and makes them difficult to free.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is extended to several related plants, including bramble-like or climbing species.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ghoul or similar demon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct lexical noun recorded under the root despite its divergent form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female animal vehemently desirous of the male.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source applies the expression specifically to a bitch; the meaning is sexual desire rather than general attachment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long tail, especially in the expression for a long or prolix narrative.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression طَوِيلُ العَوْلَقِ is explained as ‘long in the tail’ and may be applied beyond narratives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use recorded as equivalent to another term for hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dependencies, appurtenances, circumstances, or concerns belonging to a thing, person, or case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source identifies this as a post-classical technical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pendant, coin, or similar ornament suspended from a woman's jewelry; also an appendix or marginal note attached to a book.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are separate later nominal developments based on the idea of something attached or suspended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small milking vessel or drinking cup hung by a rider from the saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized container name distinguished from the general suspensory implement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who attacks and plunders, clinging to everything he finds or obtains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional characterization of a grasping raider.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An implement or utensil used by a shepherd, probably for hanging provisions or equipment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The precise object is not further identified in the lexical report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Left undecided, unresolved, or in suspense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's affair when he neither decides it nor relinquishes it; the Quranic marital specialization is listed separately under مُعَلَّقَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stirrup leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equipment sense distinct from cords and straps used to suspend objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man's tongue, especially an eloquent or forceful tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative sense based on a tongue that clings to arguments or words.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A variety or kind of palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded only in the plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A suspended cluster or bunch of grapes or dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form denotes the thing that has been hung, not the device by which it is hung.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A numerous company or collection of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal plural use describing a large group or gathering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deaths, calamities, businesses, occupations, or occurrences that divert a person from other things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is also used for matters that cause one to forget, neglect, or be unmindful of other concerns.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Direct Quran-attested blood and embryological branches.
The phrase and its proposed meaning are textually unclear.
Pasture sense and reported poetic reproductive-fluid interpretation.
The Quran-copy reference is an object example, not a Quranic sense.
The reported wolf reading may be a transcription of ‘tail’.
Passive-participial suspension sense is covered by these broader entries.
Explicit Quran citation for the marital sense.

cautions: The Quranic form عَلَق is represented by its explicitly attested clotted-blood interpretation; the contextual English gloss ‘clinging substance’ is not used by itself to create an additional sense.
The Quranic form عَلَقَة is presented as the embryological clinging or clotted blood mass described in the supplied lexical evidence; no modern biological equivalence is asserted.
Lane records textual or interpretive uncertainty for the meaning of عِلْقَاتَهُمْ and for the reported wolf reading under عَوْلَق.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:Elq:4503:g3:main: the phrase involving camels lacking عَلِقَة is damaged or uncertain in the supplied text, with the proposed reconstruction only conjectural.
lane-unit:Elq:4522:g1:sub3: the reported meaning ‘wolf’ may reflect a transcription of ‘tail’; the packet does not permit a secure assignment.
